Author: Rayla Petal
Name: WatchAlong
Description:
Puts a Kosmi room on a screen inside FFXIV, joining as a real Kosmi guest via a
sandboxed out-of-process browser, so playback stays perfectly synced with the rest of the room.

Commands:
/wa - toggle the main viewer/control window
/wa view - open the main window
/wa join <kosmi url or WA1: invite> - join a room, or accept an invite (with confirmation)
/wa settings - open Settings (identity, volume/mute, join/leave, invite, screen placement)
/wa invite - copy a shareable invite for your current room and screen
/wa sync <WA1P: message> - apply a shared screen position (with confirmation)
/wa place - open the screen placement window
/wa focus - snap the camera to a fullscreen view of your placed screen (move to exit)
/wa forgetvenues - forget every remembered watch-along room (stops auto-rejoining any of them)
/wa vol <0-150> - set volume
/wa mute - toggle mute
/wa snapshot - save a debug screenshot + DOM outline
Punchline: Watch a Kosmi room together, in-game.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: ReactToMe
Description: Listens for emotes targeted at you and applies a configured Glamourer design and Moodles status in response, automatically reverting the Glamourer design after a set duration.
Punchline: Reacts to emotes performed on you with a temporary Glamourer design and Moodle.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog:
- New look: the main window is now a dashboard. A Library sidebar (Animations, Presets), Character Tools (resync emotes, freecam) and the Live Offset editor sit on the left, the selected page in the middle, and Pairing on the right, with a color legend at the bottom. On a narrow window, Pairing moves into the sidebar.
- Presets: search by name, pose, anchor (zone, furniture or partner) or animation, and filter by type (Solo/Couple) and anchor. Presets are grouped by pose with counts, shown as compact rows with tags, and the save form is now a collapsible section.
- Animation conflicts are now a red "Conflict: keep this" button. Clicking it turns off the other mod(s) claiming the same pose, including enabled mods not listed in PoseKit, so the one you clicked plays.
- Removed Align to Target, auto-align and /posekit align. Couple presets saved with "include partner" already position you around your partner anywhere, so walking into place first is no longer needed. Couple presets now prompt your partner immediately when clicked.
- Rescan now sits next to the mod count on the Animations page. Bigger Play, Delete, Rescan and conflict buttons, and the window shows a single resize grip.

Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Oathbound
Description: A consent-based collar control plugin. Gameplay commands use ordinary in-game tells; relay-assisted pairing and encrypted catalog synchronization use the Oathbound Cloudflare service, while gameplay actions remain local to the Sub's client.
Punchline: Consent-based Owner/Sub control: outfit, title, gesture, and leash.
